text:
sara: Quick sync — we need a gating checklist for Dedicated autoscale policy before launch. who can 👍 on metrics + rollback rules? cc @devon @li

devon: high level proposal: gate on p95 token latency (<400ms), sustained queue length (<100 requests), and error rate <0.5% over 5m window. keep cooldown = 5m.

li: add cache metrics: warm KV cache hit rate >80% for the pool. if cache warm < threshold, prefer pre-warm path instead of scaling up. also track cold-start ratio.

mike: cost constraint to add: per-tenant burst credit cap. soft cap = X credits/hr (alert at 80%), hard cap = reject burst beyond 100% -> fallback to hosted model. need exact numbers from pricing.

eva: canary proposal: roll to 10% traffic for 30m, evaluate latency + output-quality diffs (embedding similarity on a small prompt set). flag any >5% quality regressions.

devon: sample policy snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "scale_up": {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "threshold": 400, "cooldown_s": 300},
  "scale_down": {"idle_window_s": 600},
  "burst": {"soft_limit_credits_hr": "<REPLACE>", "hard_limit_credits_hr": "<REPLACE>"},
  "canary": {"traffic_pct": 10, "duration_min": 30}
}
```

sara: launch checklist items I'm tracking: infra smoke, canary run, SLO verification, quota/burst policy enforced, billing + metering test, docs + customer comms, rollback playbook. draft here: https://go/redwood/dedicated-autoscale-checklist

scale-bot: deploy-bot started canary: pool=dedicated-ge-1, canary_id=canary-1845678901

mike: rollback triggers we should document: sustained error rate >1% for 5m, p99 > 2s for 5m, or cost burn > 2x forecast for 15m. any of these -> immediate scale-down + notify oncall.

eva: :thumbsup: agree with rollback rules. also include a short runbook for customer-facing incidents (who owns comms).

li: one more constraint: tenant preemption grace = 60s (signal, drain, finish KV writes). record preemption events and tenant affected count for telemetry.

sara: awesome, I'll consolidate into a PR with explicit numeric defaults and open it for review by EOD. tagging @devon @li @mike for final numbers. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
